name: explainer
description: Excalidraw with a Claude agent that explains by drawing

scripts.postinstall: d=node_modules/electron/dist; [ -d "$d/Electron.app" ] && mv "$d/Electron.app" "$d/Explainer.app"; a="$d/Explainer.app"; [ -d "$a" ] && plutil -replace CFBundleName -string "Explainer" "$a/Contents/Info.plist" && plutil -replace CFBundleDisplayName -string "Explainer" "$a/Contents/Info.plist" && printf "%s" "Explainer.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron" > node_modules/electron/path.txt && codesign --force --deep --sign - "$a" >/dev/null 2>&1; true
